name: Modeller Agents Build Workflow
description: Deterministic artifact-gated workflow for building modeller-agents structure, tooling, and skill orchestration.

steps.title: Brief And Scope
steps.exit_gate: Brief states outcome, scope, source-of-truth repositories, constraints, and acceptance evidence.

steps.title: PRD And Decisions
steps.exit_gate: PRD captures requirements and decisions captures accepted, rejected, and pending boundary choices.

steps.title: Backlog
steps.exit_gate: Backlog contains ordered stories with verification evidence for each story.

steps.title: Skills Agents Memory
steps.exit_gate: Skill surfaces, local-agent boundaries, and memory behavior are specified before implementation.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.exit_gate: Implementation artifact lists changed files, commands run, and unresolved gaps.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.exit_gate: Documentation artifact links updated docs and explains command/runbook changes.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.exit_gate: Handoff captures final state, verification, residual risks, and next actions.
